name: app-shell
summary: Desktop app: Electron shell, preload bridge, toolchain
body:
electron-vite + TypeScript strict + vitest (node & happy-dom
projects). The preload exposes exactly the IsomerApi contract via
contextBridge — contextIsolation on, no node in the renderer. A
headless ISOMER_SMOKE=1 boot path prints a marker after all three
processes load, for CI and scripted proof.
